title: Confidence allocation across a finite family
statement: Let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $\delta$ be rational with $0<\delta\leq 1/2$. The confidence parameter assigned to each member of the family is $\delta/|\mathcal F|$, which also lies in $(0,1/2]$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$
